description.value: Hester Creek Estate Winery is one of the oldest wine properties in the South Okanagan, with 58 years of history on the Golden Mile Bench wine route just outside Oliver. Cyclists can stop in for a complimentary tasting at the wine shop, enjoy a sit-down meal at the on-site Terrafina Restaurant, or extend their stay at the luxury Villa. Award-winning estate wines and vineyard views make it a standout destination on the Okanagan's wine-country cycling circuit.
